embedding_window_only_on_segment.name: embedding_window_only_on_segment
embedding_window_only_on_segment.value: ("embedding"."window_first_segment_id" is null and "embedding"."window_last_segment_id" is null) or "embedding"."source_kind" = 'segment'

flow_question_shape.name: flow_question_shape
flow_question_shape.value:
("flow_question"."scope" = 'chapter') = ("flow_question"."chapter_id" is not null)
        and ("flow_question"."scope" = 'recording') = ("flow_question"."recording_id" is not null)
        and ("flow_question"."scope" = 'tag') = ("flow_question"."tag_id" is not null)

flow_session_status_timestamps.name: flow_session_status_timestamps
flow_session_status_timestamps.value:
("flow_session"."status" = 'complete') = ("flow_session"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("flow_session"."status" = 'abandoned') = ("flow_session"."abandoned_at" is not null)

flow_session_item_shape.name: flow_session_item_shape
flow_session_item_shape.value:
("flow_session_item"."kind" = 'tag') = ("flow_session_item"."recording_id" is null)
        and ("flow_session_item"."answer" is null) = ("flow_session_item"."answered_at" is null)
        and ("flow_session_item"."start_ms" is null or "flow_session_item"."start_ms" >= 0)

highlight_shape.name: highlight_shape
highlight_shape.value:
("highlight"."kind" = 'segment') = ("highlight"."position_ms" is not null)
        and ("highlight"."kind" = 'note') = ("highlight"."note_id" is not null)
        and ("highlight"."segment_id" is null or "highlight"."kind" = 'segment')
        and ("highlight"."position_ms" is null or "highlight"."position_ms" >= 0)

generated.as: case when parent_id is null then null else false end

note_image_alt_length.name: note_image_alt_length
note_image_alt_length.value: "note_image"."alt" is null or char_length("note_image"."alt") between 1 and 200

push_subscription_keys_on_web.name: push_subscription_keys_on_web
push_subscription_keys_on_web.value: ("push_subscription"."platform" = 'web') = ("push_subscription"."p256dh" is not null and "push_subscription"."auth" is not null)

sos_report_open_reply_per_reporter_uniqu.name: sos_report_open_reply_per_reporter_unique
sos_report_open_reply_per_reporter_uniqu.where: "sos_report"."resolved_at" is null and "sos_report"."reply_id" is not null

sos_signal_closing_note_length.name: sos_signal_closing_note_length
sos_signal_closing_note_length.value: "sos_signal"."closing_note" is null or char_length("sos_signal"."closing_note") between 1 and 500

sos_signal_note_when_closed.name: sos_signal_note_when_closed
sos_signal_note_when_closed.value: "sos_signal"."closing_note" is null or "sos_signal"."closed_at" is not null

sos_signal_closer_when_closed.name: sos_signal_closer_when_closed
sos_signal_closer_when_closed.value: "sos_signal"."closed_by" is null or "sos_signal"."closed_at" is not null

user_deleted_is_deactivated.name: user_deleted_is_deactivated
user_deleted_is_deactivated.value: "user"."deleted_at" is null or "user"."deactivated_at" is not null
